decision: Do not create a separate synergy_hypergraph_core repository at this stage. Keep the canonical graph projection and inventory in Shtenco/synergy/hypergraph; reuse the existing memory dependency/evidence engine and System governance registry.

owners.role: Canonical authority map, interface registry and contract families; 0 E2E edges in the 2026-11-20 snapshot.
Commit-pinned AST dependency scans, cross-repository observations, explicit candidate edges and contract ID matching.
NEXUS inference and typed proposals; no automatic payment, ledger or deployment authority.
Local typed tool registry and deny-by-default policy; current V0.1 prototype is not production.
Manifest and service orchestration; compatibility runtime requires stronger isolation before untrusted execution.
Target transport evidence and planned mesh architecture; complete production data plane not established by inspected code.
Closed agent-economy simulation and ledger model; not real payment settlement.
Executable conversion-path/fair-value graph; not a general marketplace or transaction authority.
Accounting recognition and canonical accounting authority; main branch currently exposes contract-level artifacts, larger runtime remains in open PR/feature lines.
Provider registry, compliance/readiness gates, route selection, settlement orchestration and live-execution coordinator; live execution remains disabled by default.
Integer AMM graph-arbitrage and dual-circuit research simulation; no accounting or settlement authority.
Independent pre-trade risk veto and enterprise RBAC/audit boundary; insufficient-history handling requires fail-closed hardening.
Offline candidate scoring, human review and approval-gated CRM outbox; not a deployed public crawler or multi-tenant service.
Cesium global globe and EAEU boundary subset; not authoritative cadastral or global city-scale map data.

integration_contract.identity: Keep GitHub numeric repository ID as Hypergraph canonical node identity; map to memory engine canonical clone URL/hash without replacing provider ID.
integration_contract.evidence: Import memory engine candidate dependency records only with source and target commit SHA, file path, blob SHA, relation and confidence.
integration_contract.trust: Candidate remains candidate; source review may become reviewed; verified requires reproducible contract/runtime evidence.
integration_contract.governance: Reference System contract IDs and authority declarations; do not fork or duplicate canonical contract authority.
integration_contract.projection: Hypergraph V3 is a read model / cross-repository projection in the umbrella repository, not a new runtime or new repository.
